entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned AC to GP-4 for the State.
2. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the State seeks three weeks' time for filing counter affidavit.

3. Put up this case on 05.05.2025 at 10:30 a.m. within top ten cases.
4.
The District Magistrate, Siwan and the District Land Acquisition Officer, Siwan shall file their separate counter affidavit duly sworn by them.

The counter affidavit shall clearly record as to why the payment of compensation has not been made to the petitioner of his share when payment has been made to his four other brothers as it has been submitted by the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner that the land pertaining to Khata No. 86, Survey Khesra No. 791, Area .68 acres was acquired for construction of Ramjanki Path Pariyojna NH-227-A in terms of the notification issued under Section 3(g) Patna High Court CWJC No.3780 of 2025(2) dt.08-04-2025 of the NH Act.

It is further submitted that petitioners are five brothers and the total compensation with respect to the land acquired was assessed at Rs.56,69,846/-, as such, all the brothers had 1/5th share in the compensation amount.

It is next submitted that four brothers have already received their 1/5th share out of the compensation amount but since the petitioner is an old person aged about 80 years and is not in a position to run behind the authorities, as such, his compensation amount till date has not been paid.
